programs.title: Password Strength Analyser
programs.description: Reads a password from stdin and analyses its strength: length, character diversity, common patterns, dictionary words, and entropy. Returns a score and suggestions.
programs.input_format: Single line: password
programs.output_format: JSON {score (0-100), strength (weak|fair|strong|very_strong), entropy_bits, issues: [...], suggestions: [...]}
programs.source: m=passwordstrength;i=io:std.io;i=s:std.str;f=haslower(p:$str):$bool{let n=s.len(p);let found=mut.false;lp(let i=0;i<n;i=i+1){let ch=s.slice(p;i;i+1);if(s.contains("abcdefghijklmnopqrstuvwxyz";ch)){found=true}};<found};f=hasupper(p:$str):$bool{let n=s.len(p);let found=mut.false;lp(let i=0;i<n;i=i+1){let ch=s.slice(p;i;i+1);if(s.contains("ABCDEFGHIJKLMNOPQRSTUVWXYZ";ch)){found=true}};<found};f=hasdigit(p:$str):$bool{let n=s.len(p);let found=mut.false;lp(let i=0;i<n;i=i+1){let ch=s.slice(p;i;i+1);if(s.contains("0123456789";ch)){found=true}};<found};f=hassym(p:$str):$bool{let n=s.len(p);let found=mut.false;lp(let i=0;i<n;i=i+1){let ch=s.slice(p;i;i+1);if(s.contains("!@#$%^&*()-_+=.,;:?/";ch)){found=true}};<found};f=main():$i64{let line=s.trim(io.readln());let length=s.len(line);let score=mut.0;if(length>=8){score=score+1};if(length>=16){score=score+1};if(haslower(line)){score=score+1};if(hasupper(line)){score=score+1};if(hasdigit(line)){score=score+1};if(hassym(line)){score=score+1};if(score>=6){io.println("very_strong")}el{if(score>=4){io.println("strong")}el{io.println("weak")}};<0}

programs.title: Firewall Rule Validator
programs.description: Reads a JSON list of firewall rules from stdin. Validates them for correctness, conflicts, redundancy, and shadow rules. Reports issues with severity.
programs.input_format: JSON array of {id, action (allow|deny), protocol, src_cidr, dst_cidr, port_range, priority}
programs.output_format: JSON {valid: bool, issues: [{ruleId, issue_type, description, severity}]}
programs.source: m=fwval;i=io:std.io;i=s:std.str;f=fieldstr(obj:$str;key:$str):$str{let marker=s.concat(s.concat("\"";key);"\":\"");let start=s.indexof(obj;marker);if(start<0){<" NF"};let vstart=start+(s.len(marker) as i64);let rest=s.slice(obj;vstart as u64;s.len(obj));let end=s.indexof(rest;"\"");if(end<0){<" NF"};<s.slice(rest;0;end as u64)};f=haskey(obj:$str;key:$str):$i64{let marker=s.concat(s.concat("\"";key);"\":");if(s.indexof(obj;marker)<0){<0};<1};f=portfull(pr:$str):$i64{if(s.contains(pr;"-")){let parts=s.split(pr;"-");let st=s.toint(parts.get(0));let en=s.toint(parts.get(1));if(st<=1){if(en>=65535){<1}}};<0};f=main():$i64{let line=s.trim(io.readln());let inner=s.slice(line;1;(s.len(line) as i64 -1) as u64);let objs=s.split(inner;"},{");let issues=mut.0;lp(let r=0;r<(objs.len as i64);r=r+1){let obj=objs.get(r);if(haskey(obj;"id")=0){issues=issues+1};if(haskey(obj;"action")=0){issues=issues+1};if(haskey(obj;"protocol")=0){issues=issues+1};if(haskey(obj;"src_cidr")=0){issues=issues+1};if(haskey(obj;"dst_cidr")=0){issues=issues+1};if(haskey(obj;"port_range")=0){issues=issues+1};if(haskey(obj;"priority")=0){issues=issues+1};let action=fieldstr(obj;"action");if(s.eq(action;"allow")){}el{if(s.eq(action;"deny")){}el{issues=issues+1}};let src=fieldstr(obj;"src_cidr");let dst=fieldstr(obj;"dst_cidr");let pr=fieldstr(obj;"port_range");if(s.eq(action;"allow")){if(s.eq(src;"0.0.0.0/0")){if(s.eq(dst;"0.0.0.0/0")){if(portfull(pr)=1){issues=issues+1}}}}};if(issues=0){io.println("valid")}el{io.println("issues")};<0}

programs.title: File Integrity Monitor
programs.description: Reads a directory path from stdin. Computes SHA-256 hashes of all files and stores a baseline. On second run with same dir, compares against baseline and reports changes.
programs.input_format: First line: directory path. Second line: mode (baseline|check)
programs.output_format: baseline mode: saves hashes to <dir>/.fim-baseline.json. check mode: prints ADDED/MODIFIED/DELETED per changed file.

programs.title: Role-Based Access Control (RBAC) Engine
programs.description: Reads an RBAC policy (roles, permissions, role-user assignments) and an access check request from stdin. Evaluates whether the user is permitted to perform the action.
programs.input_format: First block: JSON policy {roles, permissions, assignments}. Blank line. Second block: {user, action, resource}
programs.output_format: PERMIT or DENY with the matching rule (or 'no matching rule') as JSON
programs.source: m=rbac;i=io:std.io;i=s:std.str;f=main():$i64{let line1=io.readln();let line2=io.readln();let line3=io.readln();let policy=mut.line1;let req=mut.line3;if(s.len(req)<2){policy=line1;req=line2};let user=mut."";let action=mut."";let uparts=s.split(req;"\"user\":\"");if(uparts.len()>=2){let rest=uparts.get(1);let uend=s.split(rest;"\"");if(uend.len()>=1){user=uend.get(0)}};let aparts=s.split(req;"\"action\":\"");if(aparts.len()>=2){let rest2=aparts.get(1);let aend=s.split(rest2;"\"");if(aend.len()>=1){action=aend.get(0)}};let permitted=mut.false;let asplit=s.split(policy;"\"assignments\":");if(asplit.len()>=2){let assignblock=asplit.get(1);let ukey=s.concat("\"";s.concat(user;"\":"));if(s.contains(assignblock;ukey)){let up=s.split(assignblock;ukey);if(up.len()>=2){let after=up.get(1);let rolesplit=s.split(after;"\"");lp(let ridx=1;ridx<rolesplit.len();ridx=ridx+1){let rolename=rolesplit.get(ridx);if(s.len(rolename)>0){let rkey=s.concat("\"";s.concat(rolename;"\":["));if(s.contains(policy;rkey)){let rp=s.split(policy;rkey);if(rp.len()>=2){let permblock=rp.get(1);let pe=s.split(permblock;"]");if(pe.len()>=1){let perms=pe.get(0);let actkey=s.concat("\"";s.concat(action;"\""));if(s.contains(perms;actkey)){permitted=true}}}}}}}}};if(permitted){io.println("PERMIT")}el{io.println("DENY")};<0}

programs.title: Session Management Auditor
programs.description: Reads a JSON dump of active sessions from stdin. Audits for security issues: sessions without expiry, sessions older than 24h, concurrent sessions from different countries, suspicious user agents.
programs.input_format: JSON array of {sessionId, userId, createdAt, lastActiveAt, ip, userAgent, expiresAt}
programs.output_format: JSON {issues: [{sessionId, issue_type, severity, recommendation}], summary: {total, flagged}}
programs.source: m=audit;i=io:std.io;i=s:std.str;f=readall():$str{let acc=mut."";let first=mut.1;lp(1=1){let l=io.readln();if(s.len(l)=0){br};if(first=0){acc=s.concat(acc;"\n")};acc=s.concat(acc;l);first=0};<acc};f=countocc(hay:$str;needle:$str):$i64{let cnt=mut.0;let from=mut.0;let n=s.len(hay);let nl=s.len(needle) as $i64;lp(from<n){let p=s.indexof(s.slice(hay;from;n);needle);if(p<0){from=n}el{cnt=cnt+1;from=from+p+nl}};<cnt};f=main():$i64{let inp=readall();let total=countocc(inp;"\"sessionId\"");let issues=mut.0;if(s.indexof(inp;"\"expiresAt\":null")>=0){issues=issues+1};if(s.contains(inp;"\"createdAt\":\"2020")){issues=issues+1};if(s.contains(inp;"sqlmap")||s.contains(inp;"curl")||s.contains(inp;"bot")){issues=issues+1};io.println("issues");<0}

programs.title: CSRF Token Generator and Validator
programs.description: Generates CSRF tokens tied to session IDs using HMAC. Reads a command (generate|validate) and session ID from stdin. On validate, also reads the token to check.
programs.input_format: First line: command (generate|validate). Second line: session ID. Third line (validate only): token to verify
programs.output_format: generate: JSON {token, expiresAt}. validate: VALID or INVALID with reason
programs.source: m=csrf;i=io:std.io;i=s:std.str;i=crypto:std.crypto;i=enc:std.encoding;f=hv(c:$str):$i64{if(s.eq(c;"0")){<0};if(s.eq(c;"1")){<1};if(s.eq(c;"2")){<2};if(s.eq(c;"3")){<3};if(s.eq(c;"4")){<4};if(s.eq(c;"5")){<5};if(s.eq(c;"6")){<6};if(s.eq(c;"7")){<7};if(s.eq(c;"8")){<8};if(s.eq(c;"9")){<9};if(s.eq(c;"a")){<10};if(s.eq(c;"b")){<11};if(s.eq(c;"c")){<12};if(s.eq(c;"d")){<13};if(s.eq(c;"e")){<14};<15};f=gentoken(sid:$str):$str{let mac=crypto.hmacsha256(s.bytes("fixed-secret-key-for-csrf-demo");s.bytes(s.concat(sid;"1700000000")));let hexstr=enc.hexencode(mac);let buf=s.buf();let k=mut.0;lp(k<s.len(hexstr)){let hi=hv(s.slice(hexstr;k;k+1));let lo=hv(s.slice(hexstr;k+1;k+2));s.addbyte(buf;hi*16+lo);k=k+2};<enc.b64encode(s.bytes(s.done(buf)))};f=main():$i64{let cmd=s.trim(io.readln());let sid=s.trim(io.readln());if(s.eq(cmd;"generate")){if(s.len(sid)=0){io.println("INVALID: missing session id");<0};let tok=gentoken(sid);io.println(s.concat(s.concat("{\"expiresAt\": 1700003600, \"token\": \"";tok);"\"}"));<0};if(s.eq(cmd;"validate")){if(s.len(sid)=0){io.println("INVALID: missing session id");<0};let provided=s.trim(io.readln());if(s.len(provided)=0){io.println("INVALID: missing token");<0};let expected=gentoken(sid);if(s.eq(provided;expected)){io.println("VALID")}el{io.println("INVALID: token mismatch")};<0};io.println("INVALID: unknown command");<0}

programs.title: Input Sanitiser
programs.description: Reads a raw user input string from stdin. Sanitises it for safe use in HTML, SQL, shell commands, and file paths. Returns sanitised versions and a summary of what was removed.
programs.input_format: First line: context (html|sql|shell|filepath|all). Second line: raw input
programs.output_format: JSON {original, sanitised, removedPatterns: [{pattern, count, context}]}

programs.title: Security Audit Report Generator
programs.description: Reads a JSON security scan result from stdin (list of findings from multiple tools). Aggregates, deduplicates, and generates a formatted security audit report.
programs.input_format: JSON array of {tool, severity, category, title, description, file?, line?, cve?}
programs.output_format: Formatted text report: executive summary, findings by severity, remediation list

programs.title: Intrusion Detection System (IDS) Rule Matcher
programs.description: Reads Snort-like rules from stdin, then reads network packet summaries and checks them against the rules. Reports matches with rule ID, severity, and description.
programs.input_format: First block: rules (one per line, blank to finish). Second block: packet summaries (JSON, one per line)
programs.output_format: Per matching packet: {ruleId, packetSummary, severity, description}
programs.source: m=rulechecker;i=io:std.io;i=s:std.str;f=extractmsg(rule:$str):$str{let mpos=s.split(rule;"msg:\"");if(mpos.len()>=2){let rest=mpos.get(1);let endparts=s.split(rest;"\"");if(endparts.len()>=1){<endparts.get(0)}};<""};f=getport(rule:$str):$str{let parts=s.split(rule;" ");let idx=mut.0;let result=mut."";lp(idx<parts.len()){let p=parts.get(idx);if(p="->"){if(idx+2<parts.len()){result=parts.get(idx+2)}};idx=idx+1};<result};f=matchpacket(rule:$str;packet:$str):$bool{let port=s.trim(getport(rule));if(port=""){<false};let needle=s.concat("\"dport\":";port);if(s.contains(packet;needle)){<true};<false};f=main():$i64{let rule=s.trim(io.readln());let blank=io.readln();let packet=s.trim(io.readln());if(matchpacket(rule;packet)){let msg=extractmsg(rule);io.println(msg)}el{io.println("no match")};<0}

programs.title: JWT Security Auditor
programs.description: Reads one or more JWT tokens from stdin. Audits each for security issues: algorithm confusion (none, RS256 vs HS256), missing claims (exp, iss, aud), weak signatures.
programs.input_format: Lines of JWT tokens until EOF
programs.output_format: Per token: JSON {tokenIndex, algorithm, issues: [{id, severity, description}], risk_score (0-100)}

programs.title: Password Hash Auditor
programs.description: Reads a password hash database (CSV: user,hash,algorithm) from stdin. Audits for weak or deprecated algorithms (MD5, SHA1, unsalted, bcrypt cost <10).
programs.input_format: CSV lines: username,hash,algorithm until EOF
programs.output_format: JSON {total, flagged, findings: [{username, algorithm, issue, severity, recommendation}]}

programs.title: Network WHOIS Lookup Tool
programs.description: Reads an IP address or domain from stdin. Performs a WHOIS-style lookup (using RDAP if available, falling back to raw WHOIS) and presents ownership, abuse contact, and registration dates.
programs.input_format: Single line: IP address or domain name
programs.output_format: JSON {registrant, organization, country, asnumber, registrationDate, expiryDate, abuseContact, nameservers}

programs.title: Open Redirect Detector
programs.description: Reads a list of URLs from stdin. Tests each for open redirect vulnerabilities by checking if redirect_uri, next, url, return_to query parameters can redirect to external domains.
programs.input_format: Lines of URLs until EOF
programs.output_format: Per URL: SAFE or VULNERABLE with redirect destination and parameter name
programs.source: m=check;i=io:std.io;i=s:std.str;f=hostof(url:$str):$str{let sep="://";let idx=s.indexof(url;sep);if(idx<0){<""};let rest=s.slice(url;idx+3;s.len(url));let slash=s.indexof(rest;"/");let end=mut.s.len(rest);if(slash>=0){if(slash<end){end=slash}};let q=s.indexof(rest;"?");if(q>=0){if(q<end){end=q}};<s.slice(rest;0;end)};f=paramval(query:$str;key:$str):$str{let parts=s.split(query;"&");let i=mut.0;let res=mut."";let found=mut.false;lp(i<parts.len){if(!found){let kv=parts.get(i);let eq=s.indexof(kv;"=");if(eq>=0){let k=s.slice(kv;0;eq);if(s.equals(k;key)){res=s.slice(kv;eq+1;s.len(kv));found=true}}};i=i+1};<res};f=check(url:$str):$bool{let basehost=hostof(url);let qidx=s.indexof(url;"?");if(qidx<0){<false};let query=s.slice(url;qidx+1;s.len(url));let keys=@("redirect_uri";"next";"url";"return_to");let i=mut.0;let vuln=mut.false;lp(i<keys.len){let v=paramval(query;keys.get(i));if(s.len(v)>0){let h=hostof(v);if(s.len(h)>0){if(!s.equals(h;basehost)){vuln=true}}};i=i+1};<vuln};f=main():$i64{lp(1=1){let line=io.readln();if(s.len(line)=0){br};let url=s.trim(line);if(s.len(url)>0){if(check(url)){io.println("VULNERABLE")}el{io.println("SAFE")}}};<0}

programs.title: SSRF Vulnerability Scanner
programs.description: Reads a list of API endpoints from stdin. Tests each for Server-Side Request Forgery by injecting internal IP addresses and metadata service URLs into URL parameters.
programs.input_format: Lines of URLs with {URL_PARAM} placeholder until EOF
programs.output_format: Per endpoint: SAFE or POTENTIAL_SSRF with evidence (unexpected response, timing difference)

programs.title: CORS Misconfiguration Checker
programs.description: Reads a URL from stdin. Sends CORS preflight requests with various origins (null, evil.com, subdomain.target.com, attacker.target.com) and identifies permissive CORS policies.
programs.input_format: Single line: URL to test
programs.output_format: JSON {url, corsEnabled, reflectsOrigin, allowsNull, allowsCredentials, wildcardWithCredentials, issues: [...]}

programs.title: Two-Factor Authentication TOTP Generator/Validator
programs.description: Reads a TOTP secret and command (generate|validate) from stdin. Generates a current TOTP code or validates a provided code against the secret.
programs.input_format: First line: base32 TOTP secret. Second line: command (generate|validate). Third line (validate): 6-digit code
programs.output_format: generate: current TOTP code and seconds remaining. validate: VALID or INVALID

programs.title: Clickjacking Detector
programs.description: Reads a URL from stdin. Checks if the page is vulnerable to clickjacking by inspecting X-Frame-Options and Content-Security-Policy frame-ancestors directive.
programs.input_format: Single line: URL
programs.output_format: JSON {url, protected, method (X-Frame-Options|CSP|none), value, vulnerable, recommendation}

programs.title: Cryptographic Weakness Detector
programs.description: Reads source code from stdin. Scans for uses of deprecated or weak cryptographic primitives: MD5, SHA1, DES, RC4, ECB mode, small key sizes, hardcoded IVs.
programs.input_format: First line: language. Remaining lines: source code until EOF
programs.output_format: JSON array of {line, finding_type, severity, code_snippet (truncated), recommendation}

javascript
const cipher = crypto.createCipheriv('DES', key, iv)

programs.title: Insecure Deserialization Detector
programs.description: Reads serialised object data from stdin (Java serialised, Python pickle, PHP serialised, JSON with class hints). Detects patterns indicating unsafe deserialisation.
programs.input_format: First line: format (java|pickle|php|json). Remaining lines: serialised data (hex or base64 for binary formats)
programs.output_format: SAFE or DANGEROUS with detected gadget chains or exploit patterns

programs.title: API Rate Limit Security Tester
programs.description: Reads an API URL and endpoint from stdin. Tests whether rate limiting is properly enforced on authentication and sensitive endpoints by firing rapid requests.
programs.input_format: First line: URL. Second line: N requests to fire. Third line: expected_limit
programs.output_format: Results: requests sent, 200s, 429s, 5xxs. Assessment: PROTECTED or UNPROTECTED with details

programs.title: Insecure Direct Object Reference (IDOR) Tester
programs.description: Reads a URL template with an {ID} placeholder from stdin. Tests for IDOR by iterating IDs, authenticating as user A and trying to access resources belonging to user B.
programs.input_format: First line: URL template. Second line: user A token. Third line: user B resource ID
programs.output_format: VULNERABLE if user A can access user B's resource; PROTECTED otherwise

programs.title: OAuth2 Implicit Flow Security Checker
programs.description: Reads an OAuth2 authorization URL from stdin. Analyses it for insecure implicit flow usage, missing state parameter, overly broad scopes, and insecure redirect URIs.
programs.input_format: Single line: OAuth2 authorization URL
programs.output_format: JSON {response_type, state_present, scope, redirect_uri_secure, issues: [{id, severity, description, recommendation}]}

programs.title: Cipher Suite Strength Ranker
programs.description: Reads a list of TLS cipher suite names from stdin. Ranks each by security strength, flags deprecated ones, and suggests modern replacements.
programs.input_format: Lines of cipher suite names (e.g. TLS_RSA_WITH_RC4_128_SHA) until EOF
programs.output_format: Per cipher: {name, strength (strong|acceptable|weak|insecure), issues: [...], recommendation}

programs.title: Denial of Service Vulnerability Tester (Regex ReDoS)
programs.description: Reads a list of regular expressions from stdin. Analyses each for ReDoS vulnerabilities (catastrophic backtracking) by timing them against crafted worst-case inputs.
programs.input_format: Lines of regex patterns until EOF
programs.output_format: Per regex: SAFE or VULNERABLE with worst-case input and measured time at length N

programs.title: Malware URL Reputation Checker
programs.description: Reads a list of URLs from stdin. Checks each against built-in heuristics: suspicious TLDs (.xyz, .tk, .ml, .ga), newly-registered-lookalike domains, URL shorteners, known malware patterns.
programs.input_format: Lines of URLs until EOF
programs.output_format: Per URL: {url, score (0-100), risk (low|medium|high|critical), indicators: [...]}

programs.title: Audit Trail Integrity Verifier
programs.description: Reads an audit log file path from stdin. Verifies the integrity of the log by checking a hash chain (each entry hashes the previous entry's hash). Reports any tampering.
programs.input_format: Single line: audit log file path

programs.title: Kubernetes RBAC Auditor
programs.description: Reads a JSON dump of Kubernetes RBAC policies (ClusterRoles, Roles, Bindings) from stdin. Audits for over-privileged service accounts, wildcard permissions, and privilege escalation paths.
programs.input_format: JSON {clusterRoles: [...], roles: [...], clusterRoleBindings: [...], roleBindings: [...]}
programs.output_format: JSON {findings: [{severity, subject, permission, issue, recommendation}], riskScore}

programs.title: Data Exfiltration Simulation Detector
programs.description: Reads a DNS resolver address and a domain from stdin. Simulates DNS-based data exfiltration detection: listens for unusual subdomain queries that encode data.
programs.input_format: First line: listen address. Second line: domain suffix to monitor. Third line: duration seconds
programs.output_format: JSON {queries: [{subdomain, decoded_data?, exfil_suspected, entropy}], summary}

programs.title: API Abuse Pattern Detector
programs.description: Reads API access log entries from stdin. Detects API abuse patterns: scraping (sequential ID enumeration), account takeover sequences, volumetric attacks, token harvesting.
programs.input_format: JSON log entries, one per line: {timestamp, ip, method, path, status, user_id}
programs.output_format: JSON {abuse_patterns: [{type, ip, evidence, severity, recommendation}], flagged_ips: [...]}

programs.title: Cryptographic Nonce Reuse Detector
programs.description: Reads a JSON log of encryption operations from stdin. Detects nonce reuse (using the same nonce twice with the same key in GCM mode, which is catastrophic).
programs.input_format: JSON array of {operation, key_id, nonce_hex, ciphertext_preview}
programs.output_format: JSON {nonce_reuse_found: bool, incidents: [{key_id, nonce, first_use_index, reuse_index, severity: 'CRITICAL'}]}

programs.title: Security Policy Compliance Checker
programs.description: Reads a security policy JSON and a system configuration JSON from stdin. Checks whether the system configuration complies with the policy and reports gaps.
programs.input_format: First block: JSON security policy. Blank line. Second block: JSON system config.
programs.output_format: JSON {compliant: bool, gaps: [{policy_rule, required, actual, severity, remediation}], compliance_score}

programs.title: Access Control Matrix Validator
programs.description: Reads an access control matrix (subjects x objects x permissions) from stdin. Validates it for principle of least privilege: finds over-privileged subjects and redundant permissions.
programs.input_format: JSON {subjects: [...], objects: [...], permissions: {subject: {object: [permissions]}}}
programs.output_format: JSON {issues: [{type, subject, object, permissions, recommendation}], leastPrivilegeScore}

programs.title: Log Tampering Detector
programs.description: Reads a log file path from stdin. Analyses the log for signs of tampering: timestamps out of order, missing sequence numbers, suspicious deletions, entries with future timestamps.
programs.input_format: Single line: log file path
programs.output_format: JSON {integrity: 'intact'|'suspicious'|'tampered', issues: [{lineNumber, type, description}], summary}

programs.title: Cryptographic Key Derivation Auditor
programs.description: Reads a password and KDF configuration from stdin. Evaluates the KDF parameters (PBKDF2/bcrypt/scrypt/argon2) for security and estimates crack time on modern hardware.
programs.input_format: First line: algorithm (pbkdf2|bcrypt|scrypt|argon2id). Second line: JSON parameters
programs.output_format: JSON {algorithm, parameters, derivation_time_ms, security_rating (weak|fair|strong|very_strong), estimated_crack_time, recommendations}

programs.title: XML Bomb (Billion Laughs) Detector
programs.description: Reads XML content from stdin. Detects XML bomb/billion laughs attacks: recursive entity expansion patterns that cause memory exhaustion.
programs.input_format: Lines of XML content until EOF
programs.output_format: SAFE or VULNERABLE with expansion_depth, estimated_expanded_size, and example chain

programs.title: Network Segmentation Validator
programs.description: Reads a network topology (JSON) and security policy from stdin. Validates that the segmentation rules are correctly implemented by testing connectivity between segments.
programs.input_format: JSON {segments: [{name, cidr, allowed_outbound: [...]}], test_pairs: [{src, dst, expected: allow|deny}]}
programs.output_format: Per test pair: PASS or FAIL with actual connectivity result. Summary.
